page: Microsoft Azure NC144ds_xl_RTXPRO6000BSE_v6 is a specialized, GPU-accelerated virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. Powered by an x86_64 Intel processor architecture, the instance provides 144 dedicated vCPUs paired with 516.0 GB of system RAM, yielding approximately 3.58 GB of memory per core. A central architectural component is the integration of an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU based on the Blackwell architecture, supplied with 96 GB of dedicated VRAM for large-footprint graphical and computational acceleration.

Data-intensive local pipelines benefit from a substantial local storage allotment comprising 7,972 GB of high-speed NVMe SSD space. The server supports Premium Storage configurations, enabling fast disk access for scratch data, large models, and cache pools directly on the physical host. Networking provisions operate without complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating standard Azure virtual network routing, private endpoints, or allocated IP configurations for public traffic.

From a cost-efficiency and hardware utilization standpoint, the instance bundles massive dedicated CPU concurrency, expansive local NVMe capacity, and a high-memory workstation-class accelerator into a single package. Workloads that cannot fully saturate both the 144 vCPUs and the single 96 GB GPU simultaneously may experience resource idling. However, for specialized processes that combine dense host preprocessing with expansive GPU memory requirements, the server minimizes host-to-device bottlenecks.

This instance profile is best suited for high-end digital content creation, large-scale visualization, CAD rendering, engineering simulation, deep learning inference, and complex data processing tasks that demand high local NVMe throughput alongside heavy GPU memory capacity.
description: Microsoft Azure NC144ds_xl_RTXPRO6000BSE_v6 is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for demanding visualization, machine learning, and compute workloads. Operating on x86_64 Intel processor hardware under Microsoft Hyper-V, it features 144 dedicated vCPUs and 516.0 GB of system memory, providing roughly 3.58 GB of RAM per vCPU. Computational acceleration is delivered by a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU equipped with 96 GB of VRAM, accommodating memory-intensive models and rendering tasks. Additionally, the instance bundles 7,972 GB of fast local NVMe SSD storage with Premium Storage capability, facilitating extreme read and write bandwidth for intermediate datasets. The server provides a high density of processing cores, fast local NVMe storage, and heavy VRAM capacity, making it well fitted for AI model inference, scientific visualization, 3D rendering pipelines, and data-heavy engineering simulations.
